January</span></span></span></h3></div><div id="comp-mn2085nm3" class="comp-mn2085nm3 nJiBti wixui-horizontal-line"></div><div id="comp-mn2085no1" class="N8MGzv _v6ohL AWXfZq PO9MfV comp-mn2085no1 wixui-rich-text" data-testid="richTextElement"><h3 class="font_3 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:26px; text-align:center;"><span style="font-size:26px;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span TOWN&nbsp;</span></span></span></h3></div><div id="comp-mn2085no7" class="N8MGzv _v6ohL AWXfZq PO9MfV comp-mn2085no7 wixui-rich-text" data-testid="richTextElement"><p class="font_8 <p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:20px;">&nbsp;</p>

<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:20px;"><span style="font-weight:bold;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">Endless waves, epic scenery, and world-class spots make every session unforgettable.</span></p>

<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:20px;">We&rsquo;ll be staying in &nbsp;just minutes from the main launch spots&mdash;so you can focus on riding and progression.</p>

<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:20px;">&nbsp;</p>

offering a <span style="font-weight:bold;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">huge open ocean playground </span>with strong side-shore winds known as the &ldquo;Cape Doctor.&rdquo; <span <p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:20px;">&nbsp;</p>

<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:20px;">With spectacular views of Table Mountain, Blouberg delivers raw ocean energy, wind reliability, and year-round adventure &mdash; <span <ul class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:20px;">
<li class="wixui-rich-text__text">

</li>
<li class="wixui-rich-text__text">
<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:20px;">want to step away from routine and reconnect &mdash; on and off the water</p>
</li>

id="comp-mn2085ov15" class="N8MGzv _v6ohL AWXfZq PO9MfV comp-mn2085ov15 wixui-rich-text" data-testid="richTextElement"><h2 class="font_5 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:26px; text-align:center;"><span style="font-size:26px;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="color:#000000;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-weight:bold;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-family:brandon-grot-w01-light,brandon-grot-w05-light,sans-serif;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">OTHER KITE SPOTS WE RIDE</span></span></span></span></h2></div><div id="comp-mn2085ow4" class="N8MGzv _v6ohL AWXfZq PO9MfV comp-mn2085ow4 wixui-rich-text" data-testid="richTextElement"><p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:20px;"><span style="font-weight:bold;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">Hermanus &ndash; Lagoon &amp; Ocean</span></p>

<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:20px;">Just a few hours south of Cape Town, Hermanus offers both a wide open lagoon and powerful ocean sessions. Steady SE winds often reach up to ~25 knots, while the lagoon provides cleaner water and space to explore downwinds and wave riding in the open sea.&nbsp;</p>

<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:20px;">&nbsp;</p>

<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:20px;"><span style="font-weight:bold;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">Misty Cliffs &ndash; Big Air &amp; Waves</span></p>

<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:20px;">Located along the dramatic Atlantic coast, Misty Cliffs delivers raw ocean energy with powerful swell and strong winds &mdash; making it a playground for big air and advanced wave riding sessions that few spots can match.&nbsp;</p>

<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:20px;">&nbsp;</p>

<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:20px;"><span style="font-weight:bold;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">Platboom &ndash; Cape Point Waves</span></p>

<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:20px;">Tucked inside Cape Point Nature Reserve, Platboom Beach is known for perfectly formed, clean waves that can reach up to ~6 m with strong SE winds. It&rsquo;s an epic choice for riders chasing powerful ocean conditions and big wave progression.&nbsp;</p></div></div></div></div><div id="comp-mn2085ow10" class="comp-mn2085ow10 FDI5TK AGREEMENT</span></span></span></p>

<p class="font_9 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:13px;"><span style="color:#000000;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-weight:normal;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-family:brandon-grot-w01-light,sans-serif;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">Kitesurfing and yoga may not be recommended and may be unsafe under certain medical conditions.</span></span></span></p>

<p class="font_9 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:13px;"><span style="color:#000000;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-weight:normal;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-family:brandon-grot-w01-light,sans-serif;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">By signing this agreement, I confirm that I am in good health and medically fit to participate in the kitesurfing sessions and yoga classes offered by Kitetravel4all SARL.</span></span></span></p>

<p class="font_9 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:13px;"><span style="color:#000000;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-weight:normal;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-family:brandon-grot-w01-light,sans-serif;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">I agree to inform my instructor of any medical conditions, injuries, pregnancy, recent surgery, or physical limitations prior to participating.</span></span></span></p>

<p class="font_9 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:13px;"><span style="color:#000000;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-weight:normal;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-family:brandon-grot-w01-light,sans-serif;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">I acknowledge that I am responsible for determining whether I am physically and medically fit to participate. I understand that participation is voluntary and involves inherent risks.</span></span></span></p>

<p class="font_9 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:13px;"><span style="color:#000000;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-weight:normal;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-family:brandon-grot-w01-light,sans-serif;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">To the extent permitted by applicable law, Kitetravel4all SARL shall not be liable for injuries or damages resulting from the inherent risks of the activities or from the participant&rsquo;s failure to follow safety instructions.</span></span></span></p>

<p class="font_9 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:13px;"><span style="color:#000000;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-weight:normal;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-family:brandon-grot-w01-light,sans-serif;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">I grant Kitetravel4all SARL permission to capture and use photographs and video recordings of me taken during the camp for promotional and marketing purposes, including social media, websites and advertising.</span></span></span></p>

<p class="font_9 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:13px;"><span style="color:#000000;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-weight:normal;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-family:brandon-grot-w01-light,sans-serif;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span class="wixui-rich-text__text">​</span></span></span></span></p>

<p class="font_9 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:13px;"><span style="font-weight:bold;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="color:#000000;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-family:brandon-grot-w01-light,sans-serif;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">BOOKING &amp; PAYMENT</span></span></span></p>

<p class="font_9 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:13px;"><span style="color:#000000;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-weight:normal;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-family:brandon-grot-w01-light,sans-serif;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">A non-refundable deposit of &euro;880 per participant, per camp week is required to confirm the booking. Each additional camp week requires a separate &euro;880 deposit.</span></span></span></p>

<p class="font_9 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:13px;"><span style="color:#000000;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-weight:normal;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-family:brandon-grot-w01-light,sans-serif;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">The remaining balance must be paid in full no later than 30 days before the start of each camp week. For bookings made 30 days or less before the start of the camp, the full amount is due at the time of booking.</span></span></span></p>

<p class="font_9 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:13px;"><span style="color:#000000;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-weight:normal;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-family:brandon-grot-w01-light,sans-serif;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span class="wixui-rich-text__text">​</span></span></span></span></p>

<p class="font_9 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:13px;"><span style="font-weight:bold;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="color:#000000;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-family:brandon-grot-w01-light,sans-serif;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">CANCELLATION POLICY</span></span></span></p>

<p class="font_9 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:13px;"><span style="color:#000000;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-weight:normal;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-family:brandon-grot-w01-light,sans-serif;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">The &euro;880 deposit per participant, per camp week is non-refundable.</span></span></span></p>

<p class="font_9 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:13px;"><span style="color:#000000;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-weight:normal;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-family:brandon-grot-w01-light,sans-serif;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">If cancellation is made more than 30 days before the start of the relevant camp week, any balance already paid will be refunded, excluding the deposit.</span></span></span></p>

<p class="font_9 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:13px;"><span style="color:#000000;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-weight:normal;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-family:brandon-grot-w01-light,sans-serif;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">If cancellation is made 30 days or less before the start of the relevant camp week, all payments made for that week, including the deposit and balance, are non-refundable.</span></span></span></p>

<p class="font_9 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:13px;"><span style="color:#000000;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-weight:normal;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-family:brandon-grot-w01-light,sans-serif;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">For multi-week bookings, these conditions apply separately to each camp week.</span></span></span></p>

<p class="font_9 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:13px;"><span style="color:#000000;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-weight:normal;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-family:brandon-grot-w01-light,sans-serif;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">The above cancellation conditions apply except where otherwise required by mandatory applicable law.</span></span></span></p></div><div id="comp-mn2085q04" class="ZfpjEV comp-mn2085q04 wixui-checkbox-group undefined"><fieldset><legend class="bOSJFy" data-testid="label-legend"><div class="H25VBr
